mapper.sql: SELECT voucher_id, voucher_no, company_id, voucher_date, period, voucher_type, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, rule_key, dept_id, user_id, total_amount, entry_count, status, attach_count, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_voucher

SELECT entry_id, voucher_id, company_id, line_no, period, dept_id, account_code, account_name, direction, amount, currency, exchange_rate, tax_amount, aux_customer_id, aux_supplier_id, aux_dept_id, aux_project_id, summary, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_voucher_entry
mapper.select: WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY line_no
WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.subject_code AS accountCode, s.subject_name AS accountName, s.level AS level, s.direction AS direction, COALESCE(l.opening_debit, 0) AS openingDebit, COALESCE(l.opening_credit, 0) AS openingCredit, COALESCE(t.debitAmount, 0) AS periodDebit, COALESCE(t.creditAmount, 0) AS periodCredit, COALESCE(l.opening_debit, 0) + COALESCE(t.debitAmount, 0) - COALESCE(l.opening_credit, 0) - COALESCE(t.creditAmount, 0) AS closingBalance FROM fin_subject s LEFT JOIN fin_ledger l ON l.account_code = s.subject_code AND l.period = #{period} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.account_code, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debitAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.direction = 'CREDIT' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id AND v.del_flag = '0' WHERE e.del_flag = '0' AND v.status IN ('AUDITED', 'POSTED') AND e.period = #{period} GROUP BY e.account_code ) t ON t.account_code = s.subject_code WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND s.is_leaf = '1' ORDER BY s.subject_code

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id AND v.del_flag = '0' WHERE e.del_flag = '0' AND v.status IN ('AUDITED', 'POSTED') AND e.direction = 'DEBIT'
AND e.period = #{period}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.voucher_id = e.voucher_id AND v.del_flag = '0' WHERE e.del_flag = '0' AND v.status IN ('AUDITED', 'POSTED') AND e.direction = 'CREDIT'
AND e.period = #{period}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_voucher ( voucher_no, company_id, voucher_date, period, voucher_type, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, rule_key, dept_id, user_id, total_amount, entry_count, status, attach_count, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{voucherNo}, #{companyId}, #{voucherDate}, #{period}, #{voucherType}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceKey}, #{ruleKey}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{entryCount}, #{status}, #{attachCount}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

INSERT INTO fin_voucher_entry ( voucher_id, company_id, line_no, period, dept_id, account_code, account_name, direction, amount, currency, exchange_rate, tax_amount, aux_customer_id, aux_supplier_id, aux_dept_id, aux_project_id, summary, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES
(#{e.voucherId}, #{e.companyId}, #{e.lineNo}, #{e.period}, #{e.deptId}, #{e.accountCode}, #{e.accountName}, #{e.direction}, #{e.amount}, #{e.currency}, #{e.exchangeRate}, #{e.taxAmount}, #{e.auxCustomerId}, #{e.auxSupplierId}, #{e.auxDeptId}, #{e.auxProjectId}, #{e.summary}, #{e.createBy}, sysdate(), #{e.remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_voucher_entry SET del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId}

UPDATE fin_voucher SET voucher_date = #{voucherDate}, period = #{period}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, entry_count = #{entryCount}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE fin_voucher SET status = 'AUDITED', audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = sysdate(), audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, update_by = #{auditBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE fin_voucher SET status = 'DRAFT', audit_by = NULL, audit_time = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND status = 'AUDITED' AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_voucher_entry WHERE account_code = #{accountCode} AND del_flag = '0'
